data.notes: April 2026 was anchored by a run of electronic music events around The Source, Chez Ali, BCKSTG, L’envers and Sonara, with traditional Moroccan music appearing in Zahria and Meydene programming.

events.title: ZONA: ARTBAT + Gordo
events.summary: ZONA debuted in Marrakech at Chez Ali with ARTBAT and Gordo on the lineup, billed as a festival-grade electronic music production.

events.title: La Zahria 2026: Ibn AlAarif Ensemble Concert
events.summary: The official Marrakech tourism site lists the 14th Zahria festival from March 22 to April 12, including an Ibn AlAarif ensemble concert on April 10 at the Farid Belkahia Museum.

events.title: Andaloussiat & Shaqariat: Le Grand Gala de la Musique Andalouse
events.summary: A one-night Andalusian music gala at Théâtre Meydene featuring Jouq Chabab Al Andalous conducted by Moulay Hicham Belghiti, with Abdellah Al Makhtoubi, Nour Eddine Tahiri and Hala Bensaid.

events.title: ODDITY ANL Marrakech
events.summary: Moroccan DJ ODDITY played an all-night-long set at L’envers, a central Marrakech electronic music venue.

events.title: Miroloja x BCKSTG
events.summary: Parisian underground duo Miroloja headlined BCKSTG at Casino de Marrakech with a house and minimal-leaning late-night set.

events.title: Sonara Festival
events.summary: Sonara’s official site confirmed a Marrakech edition on April 24 with electronic artists including Abstraal, Andhim, ANII, DJ Tomenzy, Jimi Jules, Kasia, Kawtar Sadik and Notre Dame listed.

events.title: Rosé Days Morocco
events.summary: The boutique Rosé Days series made its Morocco debut at The Source Marrakech with an all-female DJ lineup curated by Hush Hush, including Paula Tape, Kokeshi, Grace, Deatra, Rain and DJ MYMA.

events.title: Origins Spring 2026: Private Pre-Opening
events.summary: Origins Spring 2026 listed a private April 30 pre-opening at The Source with Ebba, OZ and REM, ahead of its May 1 two-stage main event.
